17 Nov 49

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. 8030
28/Shd/chl 7 37
Date July 28, 1937

Subject S.S. Bliuds, Lithuanian.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C Crawford. D.I.

(批：See also
No. 8983)

Enquiries show that the correct name of the individual mentioned in the attached report by D.S. Yamashita is S.S. Bliuds and not S.S. Fliudz. His antecedents and record as known to this office are as follows:-

Sergey Semenovich BLIUDS, former Russian subject of Jewish origin, was born in 1901 at Riga. He is known to have been residing in Shanghai for at least 8 years, during which period he is reported to have been engaged in commercial pursuits. In August, 1929 he registered with the S.C.G. Police Bureau as a r/ former Russian. In 1931 he was registered with the same Bureau as a Lithuanian citizen on the strength of certificate of nationality No 17 issued on 3-12-30 by the Lithuanian Consul in Harbin. He is known to have made several trips to Harbin, Dairen and Japan. At present Bliuds is reported to conduct an import & export business and resides together with his wife, Mrs Helene Bliuds, 30, at 868 Bubbling Well Road, Apt. 108, for which he pays $ 120 per mensem.

His elder brother Morris Bliuds, who was born on 9-4-1897 at Riga, was registered with the S.C.G. Police Bureau in May, 1930 as a Lithuanian citizen. On December 13, 1935 he arrived in Shanghai apparently from Europe and resided in this city until January 30, 1936, when he left for an unknown destination. He re-appeared in Shanghai on 24-9-36 coming from the North on board the s.s. "Tsingtao Maru". He travelled on passport No W.191 issued on 2-7-36 in Paris. After a short sojourn in Shanghai, he left for an unknown destination and is generally believed to be in Paris at present.

Bliuds brothers are suspected of being engaged in the smuggling of narcotics, but so far there is no evidence to substantiate this suspicion.

D.C. ( Special Branch)
C.
G. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

SHANGHAI)

照片
下周
1949年11月17日

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特科第一股
报告
档案号 8030
28/Shd/chl 7 37
日期：1937年7月28日

事由：S.S. Bliuds，立陶宛人。

由特别调查员普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）撰写。由警督 C. Crawford 转呈。

（批注：另见
第 8983 号）

查询显示，山下特别调查员（D.S. Yamashita）所附报告中提及之人的正确姓名为 S.S. Bliuds，而非 S.S. Fliudz。本局所知其背景及记录如下：

谢尔盖·谢苗诺维奇·布柳茨（Sergey Semenovich BLIUDS），前俄籍犹太人，1901年生于里加。据悉其在上海居住至少已有8年，在此期间据报从事商业活动。1929年8月，他以前俄国人身份在工部局警务处登记。1931年，他凭哈尔滨立陶宛领事于1930年12月3日签发的第17号国籍证书，以立陶宛公民身份在同一警局登记。据悉他曾多次前往哈尔滨、大连和日本。目前据报布柳茨经营进出口生意，与其妻海伦娜·布柳茨夫人（Mrs Helene Bliuds，30岁）同住静安寺路868号108室公寓，每月租金120美元。

其兄莫里斯·布柳茨（Morris Bliuds），1897年4月9日生于里加，于1930年5月在工部局警务处以立陶宛公民身份登记。1935年12月13日，他显然从欧洲抵达上海，并在此居住至1936年1月30日，随后前往不明目的地。他于1936年9月24日乘“青岛丸”号轮船（s.s. "Tsingtao Maru"）从北方再次出现在上海。他持有一本1936年7月2日在巴黎签发的 W.191 号护照。在上海短暂停留后，他前往不明目的地，一般认为目前身在巴黎。

布柳茨兄弟涉嫌参与毒品走私，但迄今尚无证据证实这一嫌疑。

副督察（特科）
C.
G. 普罗科菲耶夫
特别调查员

（印章：已收
1937年7月28日
上海）

（批注：归档
DBR
7月28日）

（批注：副本已由
山下特别调查员交给
桥口先生
DBR
7月28日）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
Section 1, Special Branch Station, 8030
REPORT
Date......July....23. 1937. 37

Subject...Police Assistance requested by the Japanese Consular Police.

Made by.....D. S. Kamashita..................Forwarded by............................................................

Mr. M. Hashizume , a Chancellor of the Police
Department of the local Japanese Consulate-General, states
that he would be very grateful if the Municipal Police
furnish him with information regarding a Mr. S.S.Fliudz,
aged 35, Lithuanian, Address No. 868 Bubbling Well Road.
He has a passport issued in 1937 by the Lithuanian Government,
No. 8.
This person is reported to be a member of the
"Universal Narcotic Smuggling Party" and left Shanghai for
Japan on July 6, 1937, leaving this port on board the s.s.
"Nagasaki Maru".

S. I. .................................... D. Kamashita

事由...日本领事警察请求警务协助。

撰写人.....山下特别调查员（D. S. Kamashita）..................转呈人............................................................

当地日本总领事馆警务部门书记官桥爪（M. Hashizume）先生表示，如果工部局警务处能向他提供有关 S.S.Fliudz 先生的信息，他将不胜感激。该人35岁，立陶宛人，地址为静安寺路868号。他持有立陶宛政府于1937年签发的第8号护照。
据报此人是“国际毒品走私党”（Universal Narcotic Smuggling Party）成员，并于1937年7月6日离开上海前往日本，乘坐“长崎丸”号轮船（s.s. "Nagasaki Maru"）离港。
